meaning: Invariant 1 fails. Per the frozen spec, batching as implemented is INVALID, not merely slower, and Phase 1 does not collect under it.

INVARIANT_1_SEQ_BATCH_EQUIVALENCE.mechanism: A GPUCTFVecEnv built with n_envs=B initialises B DIFFERENT episodes. Lanes are not identical at reset, before any step is taken: 1 of 8 lanes matched lane 0, max|diff| = 1.0 on the global state.
INVARIANT_1_SEQ_BATCH_EQUIVALENCE.why_this_is_more_basic_than_predicted: The prospective prediction attributed the expected failure to the shared torch.rand((B,), generator=rng) draw splitting across lanes during prefix replay. That mechanism may also hold, but it was never reached: the lanes do not share a starting episode, so batched prefix replay cannot reconstruct a common s_t at all.
INVARIANT_1_SEQ_BATCH_EQUIVALENCE.after_40_identical_steps: 1 of 8 lanes still matched lane 0, consistent with the reset-time divergence rather than with drift

INVARIANT_2_AB_PAIRED_STREAM_IDENTITY.why: invariant 1 failed; the gate requires all three together

PROSPECTIVE_PREDICTION_SCORED.predicted: invariant 1 FAILS, via per-lane deception draws causing ~3 of 32 lanes to diverge during prefix replay
PROSPECTIVE_PREDICTION_SCORED.outcome: the verdict was right, the mechanism was wrong and understated. Divergence is at reset and affects 7 of 8 lanes, not a few lanes mid-replay.
PROSPECTIVE_PREDICTION_SCORED.recorded_because: the spec required the prediction be scored plainly whether or not it held

MEASURED_BATCHING_PAYOFF_IF_IT_WERE_VALI.note: Recorded so the cost of NOT batching is on the record. It does not license batching.

WHERE_THE_TIME_ACTUALLY_GOES.reading: The environment step dominates and the GPU is idle -- 32 critic rows cost the same wall time as 1. The executing agent had predicted policy inference at ~100 ms/step and was wrong; it is 14 ms. Batching the POLICY buys nothing.

CONSEQUENCE.why: Independent B=1 cores preserve exactly the semantics already validated by Phase 0, the CRN smoke and the continuation-entropy smoke, with no environment change and none of the three invariants at risk. The env step is CPU-bound with an idle GPU, so concurrent processes should scale until CPU saturation.
CONSEQUENCE.option_1_is_larger_than_the_spec_assumed: A per-lane keyed RNG would not be sufficient. Lanes differ at RESET, so identical-start batching would require changing episode initialisation as well -- a change to the game distribution, not just to RNG ownership.
